name: qale
description: A product memory for product managers: meetings, decisions, promises and customer feedback, kept on your computer.

interface.shortDescription: Ask what was decided, promised and asked for in your meetings
interface.longDescription: Qale reads your meeting transcripts and keeps what was decided, promised, asked for and changed in a folder of markdown files on your computer. Ask what you promised a customer, who needs to know about a change, or what a set of customer calls adds up to.
defaultPrompt: Set up Qale with my licence key.
